test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following pair of industry – location is correct?

I. Iron and steel plant – Bhilai

II. Cotton textile – Lucknow
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Iron and steel plant** is located in **Bhilai, Chattisgarh.**
 
• The **cotton textile industry** is located in **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
